Sandbox_WholeLotOfLiterature_EnableMod_t: Master switch. Disable to stop adding books to loot without removing the mod.
Sandbox_WholeLotOfLiterature_SpawnRate_t: Adjust how often these books appear relative to other loot.
Sandbox_WholeLotOfLiterature_MinYear_too: The earliest publication year a book can have to spawn. Books range from 1920 to 2026.
Sandbox_WholeLotOfLiterature_MaxYear_too: The latest publication year a book can have to spawn. Books range from 1920 to 2026.
